text:
From the ritual of circumambulating the sacred altar, the thin (or slender) one rose up, and the twin (pair) was placed in the fire. Like the ends of a spine, they were ever present, mutually bound, without women.  

The two spouses, after three unions, were merged into the fire, their hands touching the flame, their eyes shining. I performed the rite for the bride and the groom, and in that blazing offering I attained liberation from shame.
